digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate criterion and acceptance-criteria evidence classification
propositions: Plan review must evaluate every acceptance-criterion checkbox independently and classify its completion evidence as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested per ADR 0043 exact-tag semantics.
Externally verifiable criteria missing the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag or carrying a malformed tag must produce a finding that remediation names the correct syntax.

Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce a finding explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof, while untagged code criteria are accepted.
Criteria bundling both repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned one evidence kind; review must direct the author to split into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.
